characterVisualization.role: Keep the selected character visible in its own presentation frame.

environment.role: Create the local environment and lock interaction context around the character.

gestures.role: Resolve and present the character's lock-picking body and hand motion.

resolution.role: Calculate the final success probability and resolve the attempt.

sequence.purpose: Present the selected character and retain its identity and frame.
Fade the lock and its immediate surroundings into the character's frame.
Show the character manipulating the lock using the selected gesture.
Expose the final chance, resolve the attempt, and present consequences.

resolution.adversityPolicy: Apply relevant conscious and subconscious adversities only when their defined trigger conditions are met; never apply a generic penalty merely because an adversity exists.
resolution.difficultySource: The environment provider supplies lock properties and task circumstances; SURPS rules map them to difficulty.
resolution.outcomeModel: Show success probability and resolve quality/degree using the selected action's outcome model.
